text: Satisfaction of the UK National Security and Investment Condition (NSAI). The scheme is expected to become effective on 31 July 2026

Brave Bison announces a formal offer of 135p per share in cash and 2.04 Brave Bison shares (with the total value per share (327p) remaining unchanged), and an alternative offer of 3.36 new Brave Bison shares for each System1 share (total value 307p per share)
Deletion: Hena Holdings had received acceptances representing 7.04% of IDH's shares, increasing its shareholding to 56.66%. The offer will remain open for acceptances until 12 August 2026
